title: MLEADERSTYLE count and lineweight domains share parser/writer validation
mode: P2 local scalar-domain correctness slice with generated ASCII/Binary controls
scope: Apply the existing MLEADERSTYLE max-segment-point and leader-lineweight domains to DXF source parsing as well as typed writing.
Preserve the writer's established max-point values -1, 0 and values at least 2; preserve the exact documented lineweight enum set.
Test every currently admitted lineweight value and the max-point boundary values, plus representative invalid values in ASCII and Binary DXF, with same-adapter recovery.

sources.title: Autodesk MLEADERSTYLE DXF group-code reference
sources.supports: Maps group 90 to maximum leader segment points and group 92 to leader lineweight.

sources.title: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDb::LineWeight enumeration
sources.supports: Defines the exact 27 supported lineweight enum values from -3 through 211, including the three symbolic negative values and the discrete plotted widths. Value -4 is marked internal-use-only.

sources.title: Autodesk ObjectARX AcDbMLeaderStyle methods
sources.supports: Documents -1 as unlimited max leader segment points. The remaining admitted values retain the existing local writer contract; this receipt does not claim broader producer qualification.

evidence.sourceCreation: Generated a rooted AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE source locally, set group 92 when testing lineweight, and transcoded the authored source to Binary DXF for binary controls. Temporary inputs are deleted after the test.

implementation.summary: Generalized DRW_MLeaderStyle::isValidDxfIntegerValue to include group 90 and group 92. The DXF parser validates signed values before assignment; the typed writer uses the same helper. The lineweight table was moved from libdxfrw.cpp into the shared validator.
behaviorChanges: Malformed source max-point and lineweight values are refused before they enter the typed model.
Existing direct-writer acceptance/refusal rules remain unchanged and now share the validator with source parsing.
Corrected valid sources import through the same reader after invalid attempts.
implementation.publicApiOrLayoutChanged: Renamed and broadened the additive static validation method; object layout and virtual interface are unchanged.

limitations: The remaining MLEADERSTYLE scalar fields, groups 174 and 178, presence/repetition/default behavior, references and version rules remain open.
No native annotation/rendering, whole-document, platform, ABI, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or producer qualification is established.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: Shared parser/writer validation for max-segment-point group 90 and lineweight group 92.
planImpact.remainingP2Scope: Other MLEADERSTYLE source semantics and handle/default/version cases, remaining MLINESTYLE edits, and LTYPE/XDATA dependency behavior remain open.
planImpact.nextImplementationPacket: Select a current, witnessed MLEADERSTYLE duplicate/presence/reference issue or LTYPE/XDATA dependency loss and implement its shared parser/planner/writer rule.

worktree: Only the listed implementation/test files, this receipt, and the plan update are part of this slice; unrelated untracked files were not staged.
